help: run every pipeline over data/input/, the one named, or one input item of it — processing only, never acquiring

args.name: pipeline
args.help: one pipeline by name (bare: all of them); validated against the pipelines that exist

args.name: item
args.help: one input item under that pipeline's root (bare: the whole root); passed to the pipeline's own singular flag

args.name: --plan
args.help: print the ordered step plan; run nothing

pip install --upgrade pip: reaches PyPI on every run to check for an upgrade; skipped with a note under YOGA_NO_SEND
pip install -r src/requirements.txt: reaches PyPI when the venv lacks packages; skipped under YOGA_NO_SEND, so a fresh venv then fails at first import, visibly
